punchline: The famous study of graduates with written goals has never been found, but a real one tied weekly updates to a friend with more progress.
thirty_sec: Brian Tracy's Goals! retells a Harvard survey in which three percent of graduates had written goals and later earned about ten times more than everyone else. Nobody has found that study. A real one at Dominican University split people into five groups. Those who wrote their goals, committed to actions and sent a friend weekly updates reported far more progress than those who kept goals to themselves.
